newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Notomas USD, Calif..
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Notomas USD, Calif..

text.p: NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN that the Board of Supervisors of Sacramento County, State of California, intends to offer for public sale on

at the hour of 10:00 a.m., California time, at Bowne of San Francisco, 343 Sansome Street, 15th Floor, San Francisco, CA 94104, $9,500,000 principal amount of general obligation bonds of the Natomas Unified School District, Sacramento County, California, designated the General Obligation Bonds, Election of 1992, Series 1997A and Series 1997B (the Series 1997A and 1997B Bonds'').

If no legal bids are received or if the Board rejects all bids, the Board may, in its discretion, receive bids again at the same place and time on each of the next three succeeding Wednesdays (until the Series 1997A and 1997B Bonds are awarded but not after June 18, 1997) upon notice given through the Thompson Municipal News or the Bloomberg News wire no fewer than 48 hours prior to the time bids are to be received. In addition, prior to the time bids are to be received, the Board may postpone the sale to the next succeeding Wednesday (but not after June 18, 1997) upon no fewer than 24 hours' notice given through the Thompson Municipal News or the Bloomberg News wire.

NOTICE IS HEREBY FURTHER GIVEN that the Series 1997A and 1997B Bonds will be offered for public sale subject to the terms and conditions of the Official Notice of Sale of the Series 1997A and 1997B Bonds, dated May 15, 1997. Copies of the Official Notice of Sale, the form of bid proposal, and a Preliminary Official Statement relating to the Series 1997A and 1997B Bonds will be furnished upon request to Liberty Public Financial Advisors, 345 Chenery Street, San
Francisco, CA 94131, Telephone: (415) 452-6805, or Kitahata & Company, 137 Joost Avenue, San Francisco, CA 94131, Telephone: (415) 337-1950.
Clerk of the Board of Supervisors
